visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with brown-tinted hair and glasses, wearing a white oversized t-shirt, stands next to a white Toyota Camry in a bright outdoor parking lot. He is smiling and opening the car's hood while speaking directly to the camera. (2) The camera pans to show the front grill and headlights of the white Camry. (3) The man leans into the engine bay, holding a smartphone to inspect the components. He points at various parts with his hands. (4) He crouches down by the front driver-side wheel, pointing at the tire and rim while explaining details. (5) The man walks around the side of the car, gesturing towards the streamlined body panels. (6) He moves to the rear and opens the trunk, standing between a white truck and the Camry, gesturing with both hands as he talks. (7) He places a black mat on the ground and sits on it, leaning back to look under the rear bumper of the car. (8) The man stands up and leans against the open trunk, talking to an off-screen individual. (9) He opens the front passenger door to reveal a young woman with a ponytail sitting inside, wearing a dark t-shirt. She smiles and waves at the camera. (10) The man and woman sit inside the car cabin; the man talks animatedly while the woman holds a notebook. (11) The man and woman stand in front of the car, engaging in a negotiation with an off-screen person representing the owner. The man makes exaggerated facial expressions. (12) The man and the owner shake hands in front of the car's rear license plate to conclude the deal.
